We have two chargers independente from each other that do not stop the main fan.
F4JCS1 and bwnWTj
The fan is just running on full speed no mather what, a reboot do not change anything, then it just starts the fan up again.
If I look in the logs the I can see the entries that it should stop, however this is not happening.
What could be the reason for this?

additional_info.subject: 0441780 - ID0441780-DC/Si-D/DK-[Multiple]Main fan run continuously CRM:00472000355
additional_info.body:
Hello Rasmus,
I attached a note in the ticket with debugstation for both chargers. Command for main fan is OFF at the moment. Please schedule a onsite intervention and connect locally a debugstation to see if the output is 0% speed rotation.
Then measure the output from PLC (0-10V DC signal). If this is 0V, and still the main fan is rotating please proceed to replace the main fan.
The measurements must be done in the front side of the charger, do not do any troubleshooting on the top of the charger unless the charger is fully switch OFF.
With best regards,
